about_the_game:
Quick summary of what this game has to offer aside from silly shenanigans.

  • Character-driven story.

  • Linear chapter progresion.

  • Turn-based combat.

  • Lots of options for battle.

  • Interesting Side Quests.

  • Makuta.

  • And Stories, of course.

His dream is... to get stronger and have LOTS of fun.

Everyone has a dream, including our main protagonists. And just by chance, Makuta's journey to find the Rainbow Gems is the perfect opportunity to achieve all of them!

You're going to follow Makuta and his friends all around Stardust Island in their journey to find the eight Rainbow Gems... for what? Uhh...

Alright, FOOL, how do I do this?!

First of all... rude.

Second of all, this game is a linear RPG with fast-paced turn-based combat. If you play your cards right, you should be able to use the best of your skills to take out all the enemies in a single turn!

All the colorful locations you'll visit have their fair share of secrets, so explore to your heart’s content, since you’ll never know what’ll be behind a closed door or a cracked wall…

But what are secrets good for if there isn't a good prize waiting for you? Well, do I have news for you!

Makuta's "No Equipment" rule that he just made up.

Makuta is a true warrior who will NOT pick up a sword or an armor to protect himself, but this is a JRPG so he's gonna need SOMETHING to help him during battles right? Well, here's ALL OF IT!

  • Fighting Styles: There's no better Fighting Style than the one you like the most! Replacing traditional equipment, you can purchase (and find through exploration) lots of different Fighting Styles, all of them change all of your stats! You want to focus on Attack? Defense? Speed? You'll find a Fighting Style that's just perfect for you!

  • Badges: Ah, yes, Makuta will allow these because they actually don't raise ANY stats! Completely useless! Well, except for the massively helpful side effects, like changing the element of your attacks, giving you a higher chance of getting a critical hit, becoming immune to a status effect or just recovering HP every turn. Want to add to Makuta's already ridiculously high chance of getting a critical hit? Yeah, sure, I don't care, go nuts.

  • Items: Not only healing items. You get bombs, clocks, giant shells, and... Well, want me to spoil the whole game for you? Enemies drop special items from time to time, so you may wanna look out for them.

Sounds interesting... Any other gimmick?

Well, you may have noticed that Makuta takes fighting REALLY seriously, so much that he'll sometimes fight ridiculously strong enemies all by himself. To accommodate for this, I had to make a few tweaks, because, if you haven't noticed, 1vs1 JRPG battles are usually a bit... uhhhh... And that's why I decided to make a whole new system for these!

But let's not get ahead of ourselves, let's speak about how battles USUALLY go, and then I'll teach you all about 1vs1 fighting.

Normal Battles: If you've played a JRPG before, you already know the drill. Command your Party Members to attack the enemies, use special attacks to get the job done faster and safer, and use items to support the ones who may be falling behind.

1vs1 Battles: When things get serious, one of your characters may want to fight alone. In 1vs1 battles you can only control one character, but you also only have to beat one enemy. You also can't use Items, but to make up for that loss you get special 1vs1 commands! You can change your Stance anytime to focus on something specific, like an Offensive Stance to go all out on Attack, or a Defensive Stance to... well, you get how it goes. There's no right way to win, just the way you feel the most comfortable with!

That's pretty much all I can say without spoiling everything!

I hope you enjoy following Makuta around and witness his development! His way of doing things and communicating with his friends! All the colorful people you'll meet along the way and of course, Makuta's party members, who he sees as his own family!

Makuta Jumpscare (not featured in the actual game).

Minimum:
  • OS: 26100.2894
  • Processor: Intel(R) Celeron(R) N4000 CPU @ 1.10GHz 1.10 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Makuta Stories is a wacky RPG all about fast-paced and exciting turn-based combat! Play as Makuta and his friends as you explore Stardust Island, engage in both normal battles and 1vs1 duels, hunt for secrets and learn lots of different Fighting Styles for you! I hope you're up for the challenge!
